newsitem.title: USA: Thompson PBE hires DLJ as adviser.
newsitem.headline: Thompson PBE hires DLJ as adviser.

text.p: Thompson PBE Inc said Tuesday it hired Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette Securities Corp as its financial adviser.
The company said in a statement that DLJ will assist its board of directors in evaluating strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value.
The company also said it had recently acquired two businesses, in Fresno, Calif., and Phoenix, with historical annual revenues of about $2 million.
The company has acquired businesses during the 1997 fiscal year with combined annualized historical revenues of over $10 million.
